supporting.text: The Statement is the middle layer of the attestation, binding it to a particular subject
Set of software artifacts that the attestation applies to. Each element represents a single software artifact. Each element MUST have `digest` set.

inference: A statement whose subject digest is not the artifact under evaluation is not evidence for that artifact. The spec states the match rule; it does not use the word evidence.
